common_fields.name: Parent_Study_ID
common_fields.label: Parent Study ID
common_fields.description: Study_ID of the record one level up in the hierarchy (experiment -> paper/study). Null for a top-level record.  The per-record aggregation level was removed on 2026-09-17; every extraction record now describes one experiment and carries its own DV contrasts.

common_fields.name: Publication
common_fields.label: Publication
common_fields.description: Merged publication form (one moderator). Controlled vocabulary: paper_peer_reviewed, paper_unreviewed, thesis, dissertation, preprint, working_paper, conference_paper, unpublished_manuscript, report. Splits `paper` into peer-reviewed vs unreviewed.

common_fields.name: Study_Description
common_fields.label: Study Description
common_fields.description: 2-sentence description of the study design and primary aim.

common_fields.name: N_Recruited
common_fields.label: N Recruited
common_fields.description: Number of participants recruited before exclusions, or null.

common_fields.name: N_Analyzed
common_fields.label: N Analyzed
common_fields.description: Final analyzed sample size, or null.

common_fields.name: N_Reported_Per_Condition
common_fields.label: N Reported Per Condition
common_fields.description: 1=cell sizes explicitly reported, 0=not reported (must be inferred), null=unclear.

common_fields.name: N_Inference_Method
common_fields.label: N Inference Method
common_fields.description: 1=Reported, 2=Equal split of total N, 3=Other (specify in Rationale_Notes).

common_fields.name: Age_Mean
common_fields.label: Mean Age
common_fields.description: Numeric mean age, or null (leave null when only a median/range/category is reported).

common_fields.name: Age_SD
common_fields.label: Age SD
common_fields.description: Standard deviation of age, or null.

common_fields.name: Gender_Ratio
common_fields.label: Gender Ratio
common_fields.description: Object mapping gender labels to percentages or counts, e.g. {"female": 59, "male": 40, "non-binary": 1}; null if not reported.

common_fields.name: Covariates
common_fields.label: Covariates
common_fields.description: Array of objects listing variables controlled for, [{"covariate": string, "dv_name": string, "r_val": number|null}]. Empty array if none.

common_fields.name: Country
common_fields.label: Countries
common_fields.description: Array of country strings, e.g. ["USA", "UK"]. Empty array if not reported.

common_fields.name: Sample_Region
common_fields.label: Sample Region
common_fields.description: Region/description when Country is not applicable (e.g. "international English-speaking", "Sub-Saharan Africa").

common_fields.name: data_url
common_fields.label: Data URL
common_fields.description: Direct URL to the dataset, or null.

common_fields.name: data_repository
common_fields.label: Data Repository
common_fields.description: Repository name/ID (e.g. OSF ujwy3, Dryad, Zenodo), or null.

common_fields.name: data_available
common_fields.label: Data Available (derived)
common_fields.description: Derived, not paper-coded: 1 when a harmonized participant-level dataset exists in `Datasets/<Study Key>/`, else 0. Populated by the reanalysis / analysis-suite scripts (`Scripts/suite_common.py:_data_available_map`).

common_fields.name: preregistration_url
common_fields.label: Preregistration URL
common_fields.description: URL of the preregistration, or null.

common_fields.name: design_factors
common_fields.label: Design Factors
common_fields.description: Array of manipulated factors, e.g. ["inoculation", "misinformation"] or ["credibility_badge", "social_norm"].

common_fields.name: clustering
common_fields.label: Clustering
common_fields.description: Clustering/random effects structure, e.g. "standard errors clustered by post", or null.

common_fields.name: Intervention_Type
common_fields.label: Intervention Type
common_fields.description: Multi-label list of intervention types from the merged vocabulary: inoculation, prebunking_warning, lateral_reading, credibility_labels, media_literacy_tips, fact_checking_training, openmindedness_intervention, debunking_and_rebuttals, community_correction, accuracy_prompts, friction, social_norms, platform_exposure_reduction, other. Multi-type experiments are allowed (e.g. ["inoculation", "friction"]). The former intervention_module field was removed on 2026-09-17; the module-specific coding fields are now implied by these types.

common_fields.name: Intervention_Type_Detail
common_fields.label: Intervention Type Detail
common_fields.description: REQUIRED when Intervention_Type includes "other"; specify the combined/specific approach. Otherwise null.

common_fields.name: Intervention_Topic
common_fields.label: Intervention Topic
common_fields.description: Topic or domain of the intervention (e.g. vaccines, climate change), or null.

common_fields.name: Intervention_Duration
common_fields.label: Intervention Duration (minutes)
common_fields.description: Numeric duration of the intervention in minutes, or null.

common_fields.name: Exposure_Schedule
common_fields.label: Exposure Schedule
common_fields.description: 1=Single massed session, 2=Spaced (multiple continuous sessions), 3=Boosted (delayed follow-up session).

common_fields.name: Attention_Cues
common_fields.label: Attention Cues
common_fields.description: Array of applicable strings: ["Visual Signaling/Highlighting", "Explicit Ignore Instructions", "Physiological/Emotional Focus"].

common_fields.name: Media_Support
common_fields.label: Media Support
common_fields.description: Array of applicable strings: ["Model teaching", "Visual aids"].

common_fields.name: Comm_Strategies
common_fields.label: Communication Strategies
common_fields.description: Array of applicable strings: ["Interview techniques", "Sketching/narrative", "Verbal labelling"].

common_fields.name: Practice_Strategy
common_fields.label: Practice Strategy
common_fields.description: Array of applicable strings: ["Recall tests", "Easy-to-hard sequencing"].

common_fields.name: Stimuli_Topic
common_fields.label: Stimuli Topic
common_fields.description: Topic or domain of the stimuli, or null.

common_fields.name: Rationale_Notes
common_fields.label: Rationale Notes
common_fields.description: Brief note on inferred values, group-size inference, and effect-size conversions. Empty string if none.

common_fields.name: Fulltext_Exclusion_Criterion
common_fields.label: Full-text exclusion criterion (C1-C4)
common_fields.description: Leave EMPTY when the study meets every inclusion criterion. Otherwise list the unmet criterion/criteria: C1 = No misinformation intervention; C2 = No control/comparison group; C3 = Not English; C4 = Not a primary experimental study. A study that fails a criterion is STILL fully coded, harmonized and reproduced as normal.

options.label: insufficient reporting (study ran, but no eligible contrast is reported)
duplicate of an included study (non-independent report)

common_fields.name: Corresponding_Author_Name
common_fields.label: Corresponding author (name)
common_fields.description: Name of the author the paper directs correspondence to, e.g. "Jane Roe". Empty when the paper names no corresponding author. Recorded separately from the address in 'Corresponding_Author_Email'.

common_fields.name: Corresponding_Author_Email
common_fields.label: Corresponding author (email)
common_fields.description: E-mail address of the corresponding author, as printed in the paper. Empty when no address is printed or none could be resolved to the corresponding author.

common_fields.name: Corresponding_Author_Source
common_fields.label: Corresponding author (source)
common_fields.description: Where the corresponding author was read from, e.g. "pdf: correspondence note, p. 1" or "openalex: corresponding_author_ids".

dv_fields.name: dv_domain
dv_fields.label: DV Domains
dv_fields.description: Controlled multi-label list: technique_recognition, credibility, sharing_intention, search_behavior, attitude_policy, trust, media_literacy_attitudes, critical_thinking, other.  The former levels echo_chamber, information_overload, social_norms, behavioral_choice and general_transfer were merged into "other" on 2026-09-17; confidence and affect were merged into "other", engagement_behavior into "sharing_intention", and belief_accuracy into "credibility" on 2026-09-19.

dv_fields.name: score_types
dv_fields.label: Score Types
dv_fields.description: Controlled multi-label list: separate_true, separate_false, separate_manipulative, separate_nonmanipulative, discernment_difference, composite, signal_detection_auc, signal_detection_d_prime, signal_detection_c, dichotomous_accuracy, continuous_accuracy, proportion, proportion_difference, behavioral_choice, other, count, single_item, behavioral_intention, change_score, signal_detection_other.

dv_fields.name: discernment_defined_as
dv_fields.label: Discernment Defined As
dv_fields.description: How a difference/discernment score is computed, e.g. "manipulative minus non-manipulative", or null.

dv_fields.name: dv_polarity
dv_fields.label: DV Polarity
dv_fields.description: 1=higher score is better/protective, 0=higher score is worse, null=not applicable.

dv_fields.name: scale_points
dv_fields.label: Scale Points
dv_fields.description: Number of response scale points, if applicable.

dv_fields.name: comparison_label
dv_fields.label: Comparison Label
dv_fields.description: Label of the specific contrast and timepoint, e.g. "Good Bad Vaxx vs Control (post)".

dv_fields.name: group1_label
dv_fields.label: Group 1 Label
dv_fields.description: First group name in the comparison.

dv_fields.name: group2_label
dv_fields.label: Group 2 Label
dv_fields.description: Second group name in the comparison.

dv_fields.name: contrast_type
dv_fields.label: Contrast Type
dv_fields.description: 1=Primary treatment vs no-treatment control, 2=Treatment vs active/placebo control, 3=Dose-response, 4=Within-person, 5=Factorial main effect, 6=Simple effect, 7=Other, 8=Misinformation vs no misinformation, 9=Informative message vs control, 10=Factorial interaction, 11=Omnibus model term, 12=Moderator main effect, 13=Non-intervention factor.

dv_fields.name: eligible_primary
dv_fields.label: Eligible Primary
dv_fields.description: 1=eligible primary meta-analytic contrast (intervention vs no-inoculation control), 0=not primary, null=unclear.

options.label: eligible primary meta-analytic contrast (intervention vs no-inoculation control)

dv_fields.name: timepoint_2
dv_fields.label: Timepoint 2
dv_fields.description: Second timepoint label, or null for cross-sectional single-time contrasts.

dv_fields.name: delay_weeks
dv_fields.label: Delay (weeks)
dv_fields.description: Numeric delay in weeks; null if only immediate effects are reported.

dv_fields.name: n1i
dv_fields.label: N Group 1
dv_fields.description: Sample size group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: m1i
dv_fields.label: Mean Group 1
dv_fields.description: Mean group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: sd1i
dv_fields.label: SD Group 1
dv_fields.description: SD group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: n2i
dv_fields.label: N Group 2
dv_fields.description: Sample size group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: m2i
dv_fields.label: Mean Group 2
dv_fields.description: Mean group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: sd2i
dv_fields.label: SD Group 2
dv_fields.description: SD group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: n_total
dv_fields.label: Total N
dv_fields.description: Total N for correlation/statistical fallback conversions.

dv_fields.name: beta_val
dv_fields.label: Regression Beta
dv_fields.description: Unstandardized or standardized regression coefficient (state which in conversion_method).

dv_fields.name: beta_se
dv_fields.label: Regression Beta SE
dv_fields.description: Standard error of the regression coefficient.

dv_fields.name: or_ci_low
dv_fields.label: Odds Ratio CI Low
dv_fields.description: Lower bound of the odds-ratio confidence interval.

dv_fields.name: or_ci_high
dv_fields.label: Odds Ratio CI High
dv_fields.description: Upper bound of the odds-ratio confidence interval.

dv_fields.name: p_val
dv_fields.label: p Value
dv_fields.description: Exact p-value, or the reported bound when censored.

dv_fields.name: eta2_p_ci_low
dv_fields.label: Partial Eta Squared CI Low
dv_fields.description: Lower bound of the partial eta-squared CI.

dv_fields.name: eta2_p_ci_high
dv_fields.label: Partial Eta Squared CI High
dv_fields.description: Upper bound of the partial eta-squared CI.

dv_fields.name: yi
dv_fields.label: Effect Size (yi)
dv_fields.description: Standardized effect size estimate used for meta-analysis.

dv_fields.name: sei
dv_fields.label: Effect Size SE (sei)
dv_fields.description: Standard error of the effect size.

dv_fields.name: effect_size_type_reported
dv_fields.label: Effect Size Type Reported
dv_fields.description: Which effect size the paper reported - d, g, eta2p, beta, odds_ratio, r, none.

dv_fields.name: effect_direction_meaning
dv_fields.label: Effect Direction Meaning
dv_fields.description: Interpretation of a positive sign (e.g. "positive = treatment reduced misinformation beliefs").

dv_fields.name: conversion_method
dv_fields.label: Conversion Method
dv_fields.description: How yi/vi were obtained, e.g. "reported d", "t+n to d", "d to vi formula".

dv_fields.name: cell_descriptives
dv_fields.label: Cell Descriptives
dv_fields.description: Array of objects, one per group-time cell, each {"group": string, "timepoint": string, "n": number|null, "mean": number|null, "sd": number|null}.

dv_fields.name: missing_metrics_reason
dv_fields.label: Missing Metrics Reason
dv_fields.description: Short explanation when no full descriptives or fallback statistics are available; empty string otherwise.

dv_fields.name: source_location
dv_fields.label: Source Location
dv_fields.description: Where the statistic is reported in the paper, e.g. "Table 2, p. 7", "Fig. 1", "Sect. 3.2"; empty string when truly absent.

dv_fields.name: source_quote
dv_fields.label: Source Quote
dv_fields.description: Verbatim statistic from the paper, e.g. "d = 0.31, 95% CI [0.12, 0.50]"; must be findable in Text/<Key>.txt after whitespace normalisation.

inoculation.label: Psychological Inoculation / Prebunking
inoculation.description: Boost and refutation strategy that pre-emptively exposes individuals to a weakened form of misinformation or manipulation techniques to build psychological resilience and recognition competences (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Inoculation_Target
fields.label: Inoculation Target
fields.description: 1=Fact-based, 2=Technique-based, 3=Logic-based.

fields.name: Threat_Warning
fields.label: Threat Warning
fields.description: 0=Absent, 1=Implicit, 2=Explicit forewarning.

fields.name: Manipulation_Strategy
fields.label: Manipulation Strategies
fields.description: Verbatim list of techniques refuted, e.g. ["Ad Hominem", "False Cause", "Bandwagon", "Emotional storytelling", "Fake experts", "Naturalistic fallacy", "Conspiracy theories", "False balance"].

fields.name: Active_vs_Passive
fields.label: Active vs Passive
fields.description: 1=Passive inoculation (text reading, video viewing), 2=Active inoculation (gamified interactive roleplay), 3=Mixed.

fields.name: Perspective_Taking
fields.label: Perspective Taking
fields.description: 0=None/neutral, 1=Defender perspective, 2=Misinformation creator/evil perspective (e.g. Bad News game), 3=Both.

options.label: Misinformation creator/evil perspective (e.g. Bad News game)

fields.name: Technique_Count
fields.label: Number of Techniques
fields.description: Number of manipulation techniques explicitly taught/refuted, or null.

fields.name: Technique_Taxonomy
fields.label: Standardized Technique Taxonomy
fields.description: Standardized controlled names: ["emotional_manipulation", "fake_experts", "conspiracy", "polarization", "amplification", "trolling", "naturalistic_fallacy", "ad_hominem", "false_dichotomy", "coherence_break", "discrediting", "scapegoating", "false_balance"].

fields.name: Forewarning_Explicitness
fields.label: Forewarning Explicitness
fields.description: 0=Absent, 1=Implicit, 2=Explicit.

fields.name: Refutation_Present
fields.label: Refutation Present
fields.description: 1=Explicit refutation included, 0=Threat forewarning only, null=Unclear.

fields.name: Immunizing_Message_Length_Words
fields.label: Immunizing Message Length (words)
fields.description: Word count of the inoculation/immunizing text, or null.

fields.name: Booster_Session_Administered
fields.label: Booster Session Administered
fields.description: 0=No booster, 1=Booster administered at follow-up.

fields.name: Booster_Content
fields.label: Booster Content
fields.description: Description of any delayed booster session content, or null.

fields.name: Longevity_Test_Delay_Days
fields.label: Follow-up Delay (Days)
fields.description: Days between inoculation and delayed post-test, or 0 if immediate only.

lateral_reading_and_verification.label: Lateral Reading and Verification Strategies
lateral_reading_and_verification.description: Boosts and educational interventions that teach explicit digital verification strategies used by professional fact-checkers, specifically leaving a website to evaluate its credibility via independent queries (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Supersedes the earlier `sourcing.yaml` module (kept as an alias). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Verification_Strategy_Type
fields.label: Strategy Taught
fields.description: List of verification heuristics taught: ["lateral_reading", "reverse_image_search", "click_restraint", "wikipedia_source_tracking", "original_context_tracing", "source_credibility_check", "fact_checking_site_use", "CRAAP_checklist"].

fields.name: Educational_Format
fields.label: Format of Instruction
fields.description: 1=Classroom curriculum/course modules (teacher modeling and guided practice), 2=Short standalone instructional video, 3=Gamified interactive learning module, 4=Prompt/pop-up nudge during browsing, 5=Written guidelines/cheatsheet, 6=Self-guided web platform, 7=Other.

options.label: Classroom curriculum/course modules (teacher modeling and guided practice)

fields.name: Instructional_Duration_Minutes
fields.label: Instruction Duration (Minutes)
fields.description: Total exposure in minutes (or estimate for a curriculum).

fields.name: Assessment_Paradigm
fields.label: Assessment Paradigm
fields.description: 1=Technique-adoption paradigm (authentic web evaluation with screen recording/digital trace), 2=Controlled website credibility judgment task, 3=Self-reported verification-strategy usage, 4=Knowledge/skill assessment quiz.

options.label: Technique-adoption paradigm (authentic web evaluation with screen recording/digital trace)

fields.name: Tracked_Behavioral_Indicators
fields.label: Tracked Web Navigation Behaviors
fields.description: List of tracked metrics: ["opened_new_tabs", "search_engine_queries", "time_on_source_domain", "external_credibility_references"].

fields.name: Target_Audience_Level
fields.label: Target Population
fields.description: 1=Middle/high-school students, 2=College/university students, 3=General adult public, 4=Older adults, 5=Professionals (e.g. teachers, journalists).

fields.name: Intervention_Source_Concept
fields.label: Source Concept
fields.description: 1=Sourcing, 2=Lateral Reading, 3=Both/Mixed. Sourcing = leaving the text to assess author/publisher credibility via third-party sources.

options.label: Both/Mixed. Sourcing = leaving the text to assess author/publisher credibility via third-party sources

fields.name: Search_Task
fields.label: Search Task
fields.description: Description of the search/evaluation task participants completed, or null.

fields.name: Training_Strategies
fields.label: Training Strategies
fields.description: Array: ["Explicit strategy instruction", "Modeling/demonstration", "Scaffolded practice", "Feedback", "Group discussion"].

fields.name: Human_Trainer
fields.label: Human Trainer
fields.description: 1=Researcher, 2=Teacher, 3=Peer, 4=Computer/AI, 5=Other.

media_literacy_tips.label: Media-Literacy Tips
media_literacy_tips.description: Educational boost interventions providing concise, actionable heuristic rules for spotting false, deceptive, or misleading content directly in social media feeds (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Tips_Content_Checklist
fields.label: Specific Tips Included
fields.description: Subset of tips: ["be_skeptical_of_headlines", "inspect_the_url", "investigate_the_source", "watch_for_unusual_formatting", "check_the_photos_images", "inspect_dates", "check_evidence_and_references", "cross_check_other_reports", "check_if_satire", "consider_the_source", "look_for_expert_consensus"].

fields.name: Delivery_Channel
fields.label: Delivery Channel
fields.description: 1=Static graphic/infographic embedded in feed/survey, 2=Platform advertisement/sponsored post (e.g. Meta tips campaign), 3=Text message/ WhatsApp micro-course, 4=Print pamphlet/flyer, 5=Short video clip, 6=Other.

options.label: Platform advertisement/sponsored post (e.g. Meta tips campaign)

fields.name: Exposure_Frequency
fields.label: Delivery Schedule
fields.description: 1=Single one-off exposure, 2=Multi-day repeated micro-lessons (e.g. 5-day SMS), 3=Always-accessible sidebar/guide.

fields.name: Geographic_Setting
fields.label: Geographic / Economic Context
fields.description: 1=Global North, 2=Global South, 3=Cross-national, 4=Other/unclear.

fields.name: Target_Sample_Literacy
fields.label: Target Sample Demographics
fields.description: 1=General urban/internet users, 2=Rural / lower education and digital literacy population, 3=Mixed.

options.label: Rural / lower education and digital literacy population

fields.name: Discernment_vs_General_Skepticism
fields.label: Evaluated Discernment Effect
fields.description: 1=Selective discernment increased (lower belief/sharing of false, preserved belief of true), 2=General skepticism induced (decreased belief in both true and false), 3=No significant effect.

options.label: Selective discernment increased (lower belief/sharing of false, preserved belief of true)
General skepticism induced (decreased belief in both true and false)

fields.name: Tip_Topic_Specific
fields.label: Topic-Specific vs General
fields.description: 1=Generic/topic-agnostic tips, 0=Topic-specific tips, null=Unclear.

fact_checking_training.label: Fact-Checking Training
fact_checking_training.description: Skills-training interventions that teach participants to actively verify claims and content (claim decomposition, search operators, fact-checking websites, reverse image search, SIFT). Distinguished from source-focused lateral reading and from tip-only nudges. Use with the common core.

fields.name: Fact_Check_Strategy
fields.label: Strategy Taught
fields.description: Subset: ["claim_decomposition", "search_operator_use", "fact_checking_website_use", "reverse_image_search", "original_context_tracing", "SIFT", "evidence_tracing", "expert_consensus_lookup"].

fields.name: Training_Focus
fields.label: Training Focus
fields.description: 1=Claim/fact verification, 2=Source verification, 3=Both claim and source, 4=Other.

fields.name: Training_Format
fields.label: Training Format
fields.description: 1=Direct instruction, 2=Modeling/demonstration, 3=Scaffolded practice with feedback, 4=Gamified practice, 5=Self-directed materials, 6=Mixed.

fields.name: Instructor_Type
fields.label: Instructor Type
fields.description: 1=Researcher, 2=Teacher, 3=Peer, 4=Computer/AI, 5=Anthropomorphic agent, 6=Other.

fields.name: Instructional_Duration_Minutes
fields.label: Instruction Duration (Minutes)
fields.description: Total instruction/exposure time in minutes, or null.

fields.name: Assessment_Paradigm
fields.label: Assessment Paradigm
fields.description: 1=Claim-verification accuracy task, 2=Discernment (true vs false), 3=Source-credibility judgment, 4=Behavioural search trace, 5=Self-report, 6=Mixed.

fields.name: Transfer_Task
fields.label: Transfer Task
fields.description: Description of any novel-context transfer task, or null.

fields.name: Feedback_Provided
fields.label: Feedback Provided
fields.description: 1=Yes (corrective/elaborated feedback during practice), 0=No, null=Unclear.

openmindedness_intervention.label: Open-Mindedness / Actively Open-Minded Thinking
openmindedness_intervention.description: Interventions that train open-minded, reflective, or perspective-taking dispositions (actively open-minded thinking, consider-the-opposite, intellectual humility, values affirmation) to reduce myside/identity-protective reasoning about (mis)information. Use with the common core.

fields.name: Mechanism
fields.label: Mechanism
fields.description: 1=Actively open-minded thinking (AOT) training, 2=Consider-the-opposite/ counterargument generation, 3=Perspective-taking induction, 4=Intellectual-humility training, 5=Values affirmation, 6=Reflection/ metacognitive prompt, 7=Other.

fields.name: Target_Response
fields.label: Target Response
fields.description: 1=Belief updating/receptivity to correction, 2=Myside bias reduction, 3=Sharing behaviour, 4=Openness attitudes, 5=Multiple.

fields.name: Session_Structure
fields.label: Session Structure
fields.description: 1=Single brief exercise, 2=Multi-session training, 3=Integrated into curriculum, 4=Booster session.

fields.name: Delivered_Via
fields.label: Delivered Via
fields.description: 1=Text exercise, 2=Video, 3=Interactive dialogue, 4=Group discussion, 5=Task/quiz, 6=Mixed.

fields.name: Instructional_Duration_Minutes
fields.label: Instruction Duration (Minutes)
fields.description: Total duration in minutes, or null.

fields.name: Outcome_Measures
fields.label: Outcome Measures
fields.description: Array, e.g. ["AOT scale", "receptiveness to opposing views", "belief accuracy", "sharing intentions"].

debunking_and_rebuttals.label: Debunking and Rebuttals
debunking_and_rebuttals.description: Refutation strategies that dispel misconceptions, counter false beliefs, and attenuate the continued influence of misinformation by providing corrective factual information or dissecting misleading argumentation (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Refutation_Type
fields.label: Refutation Strategy Type
fields.description: 1=Topic rebuttal / factual debunking (correcting facts directly), 2=Technique rebuttal (exposing rhetorical tactics/fallacies), 3=Combined topic and technique rebuttal.

options.label: Topic rebuttal / factual debunking (correcting facts directly)

fields.name: Correction_Structure_Steps
fields.label: Four-Step Structure Compliance
fields.description: Subset of the 4 debunking steps present: ["fact_first_statement", "salience_warning_pre_exposure", "misinformation_specification_and_flaw_explanation", "alternative_causal_explanation"].

fields.name: Alternative_Causal_Explanation_Present
fields.label: Alternative Causal Explanation Present
fields.description: 1=Explicit alternative causal model provided, 0=Simple retraction/negation only, null=Unclear.

fields.name: Narrative_Format
fields.label: Correction Format
fields.description: 1=Narrative correction (story/case-based), 2=Non-narrative correction (factual/list-based), 3=Visual/infographic.

fields.name: Correction_Source
fields.label: Source of Debunking
fields.description: 1=Professional independent fact-checker, 2=Government/public-health institution, 3=Peer/social correction (user comment), 4=Algorithmic/ platform system message, 5=Anonymous/unattributed source, 6=Trusted messenger (e.g. local health worker), 7=Other.

fields.name: Timing_Relative_to_Misinformation
fields.label: Timing of Correction
fields.description: 1=Immediate correction (same exposure instance), 2=Delayed correction (subsequent session/turn), 3=Pre-exposure rebuttal.

fields.name: Misinformation_Continued_Influence_Assessed
fields.label: Continued Influence Effect (CIE) Measured
fields.description: 1=Yes (open-ended inferential reasoning/scenario comprehension), 0=No (isolated item belief/accuracy rating only).

fields.name: Repeated_Correction
fields.label: Repeated Correction
fields.description: 1=Yes (same correction delivered more than once), 0=No, null=Unclear.

options.label: Yes (same correction delivered more than once)

fields.name: Threat_to_Worldview
fields.label: Identities/Worldviews Threat
fields.description: 1=Yes (correction challenges a salient identity/worldview), 0=No, null=Unclear.

community_correction.label: Community / Collective Correction
community_correction.description: Crowdsourced or peer-driven corrections and collective judgments (community notes, user comments, collective-intelligence platforms, peer flagging) that counter misinformation through aggregated social input. Use with the common core.

fields.name: Crowd_Mechanism
fields.label: Crowd Mechanism

fields.name: Visibility

fields.description: 1=Visible to all users, 2=Visible only to a subgroup, 3=Collapsed/behind a click, null=Unclear.

fields.description: 1=Belief accuracy, 2=Sharing/engagement, 3=Correction adoption, 4=Discernment, 5=Multiple.

fields.label: Assessment Paradigm
fields.description: 1=Headline-discernment, 2=Real platform field experiment, 3=Simulated feed, 4=Longitudinal trace, 5=Other.

source_credibility_labels.label: Source-Credibility Labels
source_credibility_labels.description: Refutation/decision-support intervention displaying independent professional ratings of the overall journalistic credibility and transparency of news sources and domains (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core. NOTE: a label is information provision, not skills training. If no skill is taught, route here rather than to lateral_reading_and_verification.

fields.name: Rating_System
fields.label: Credibility System
fields.description: 1=Continuous journalistic index (e.g. NewsGuard 0-100), 2=Categorical/ color-coded badge (green trustworthy/red untrustworthy), 3=Binary trust seal/warning shield, 4=Crowdsourced trust metric, 5=The Trust Project transparency indicators, 6=Other.

fields.name: Unit_of_Evaluation
fields.label: Evaluated Unit
fields.description: 1=Domain/news-outlet level, 2=Specific publication channel/page, 3=Individual author/journalist.

fields.name: Interface_Integration_Method
fields.label: Interface Integration Method
fields.description: 1=Browser extension/add-on in natural browsing, 2=In-feed badge beside the headline, 3=Search-engine results page snippet label, 4=Survey experimental card overlay, 5=Other.

fields.name: Metric_Transparency_Degree
fields.label: Information Detail Provided
fields.description: 1=Simple badge/score only, 2=Expandable nutrition label with specific criteria (transparency, corrections, ownership).

options.label: Expandable nutrition label with specific criteria (transparency, corrections, ownership)

fields.name: Information_Diet_Quality_Assessed
fields.label: Information Diet Quality Assessed
fields.description: 1=Yes (tracked domain visits/exposure quality via digital trace), 0=No (isolated headline evaluation only).

options.label: Yes (tracked domain visits/exposure quality via digital trace)

fields.name: Label_Provider
fields.label: Label Provider
fields.description: 1=Independent rating org (NewsGuard/Trust Project), 2=Platform, 3=Researchers, 4=Crowd, 5=Other.

warning_and_fact_checking_labels.label: Warning and Fact-Checking Labels
warning_and_fact_checking_labels.description: Refutation interventions that explicitly alert users to contested, misleading, or debunked individual content items, indicating professional fact-checker ratings (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Label_Type
fields.label: Label Type
fields.description: 1=General warning label (content may be disputed/inaccurate), 2=Specific fact-checking label (fact-checker attribution + rating), 3=Contextual information label (background without rating).

options.label: General warning label (content may be disputed/inaccurate)

fields.name: Rating_Granularity
fields.label: Veracity Rating Granularity
fields.description: 1=Binary ("False"/"Disputed"), 2=Graded/multi-level (e.g. False, Partly False, Altered, Missing Context), 3=Numeric scale.

options.label: Graded/multi-level (e.g. False, Partly False, Altered, Missing Context)

fields.name: Display_Timing_and_Salience
fields.label: Display Mode
fields.description: 1=In-line tag below/above headline, 2=Interstitial warning/obscuring overlay (click-through), 3=Post-interaction warning (after share click).

fields.name: Fact_Checker_Identity_Visible
fields.label: Fact-Checking Source Disclosed
fields.description: 1=Named independent fact-checker (PolitiFact, Snopes), 2=Platform message ("Independent fact-checkers"), 3=Unspecified source.

fields.name: Implied_Truth_Effect_Tested
fields.label: Implied Truth Effect Tested
fields.description: 1=Yes (tested whether unlabelled false headlines gained spurious accuracy), 0=No (only labelled vs control).

options.label: Yes (tested whether unlabelled false headlines gained spurious accuracy)

fields.name: Primary_Outcome_Variable
fields.label: Primary Evaluated Outcome

accuracy_prompts.label: Accuracy Prompts
accuracy_prompts.description: Nudging interventions that shift attention to the concept of accuracy before sharing or evaluating online content, mitigating inattention-driven misinformation spread (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Prompt_Mechanism
fields.label: Prompt Mechanism
fields.description: 1=Direct headline accuracy evaluation (rate veracity of a single neutral/unrelated headline), 2=Explicit prime/reminder (text prompt reminding user accuracy matters), 3=Educational video/multimedia prime on the value of accurate information, 4=Passive accuracy salience banner/header, 5=Other prompt format.

options.label: Direct headline accuracy evaluation (rate veracity of a single neutral/unrelated headline)
Explicit prime/reminder (text prompt reminding user accuracy matters)
Educational video/multimedia prime on the value of accurate information

fields.name: Evaluation_Item_Veracity
fields.label: Veracity of Prompt Item
fields.description: 1=True, 2=False, 3=Neutral/non-political, 4=Both true and false shown, null=Not applicable.

fields.name: Evaluation_Item_Political_Concordance
fields.label: Political Concordance of Prompt Headline
fields.description: 1=Politically concordant, 2=Politically discordant, 3=Politically neutral/apolitical, null=Not applicable.

fields.name: Prompt_Timing
fields.label: Timing of Prompt
fields.description: 1=Prior to feed browsing task, 2=In-line during feed browsing (periodically), 3=At immediate point of sharing decision.

options.label: At immediate point of sharing decision

fields.name: Delivery_Context
fields.label: Delivery Context
fields.description: 1=Survey/lab simulation (headline-discernment paradigm), 2=Social media platform direct message (field experiment, e.g. Twitter DM), 3=Platform public feed/interstitial.

fields.name: Primary_Discernment_Metric
fields.label: Primary Discernment Metric
fields.description: 1=Sharing discernment (Sharing True minus Sharing False), 2=Accuracy discernment (Belief True minus Belief False), 3=Raw false-sharing reduction only, 4=Quality score of shared domains (digital trace data).

options.label: Sharing discernment (Sharing True minus Sharing False)
Accuracy discernment (Belief True minus Belief False)
Quality score of shared domains (digital trace data)

friction.label: Friction
friction.description: Nudging interventions that introduce behavioral or cognitive slowing into social sharing pathways to disrupt impulsive sharing and encourage deliberative evaluation (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Friction_Mechanism
fields.label: Friction Mechanism
fields.description: 1=Read-before-sharing prompt (open/read article link), 2=Pause-and-think reflection prompt, 3=Second-step confirmation modal (extra click), 4=Cognitive justification requirement (write why true/false), 5=Time delay constraint (mandatory wait timer), 6=Other.

fields.name: Friction_Modality
fields.label: Modal Interface Type
fields.description: 1=Non-blocking warning/banner, 2=Blocking pop-up modal requiring user input, 3=Hard delay timer.

options.label: Blocking pop-up modal requiring user input

fields.name: Target_Action
fields.label: Action Subject to Friction
fields.description: 1=Share/Retweet action, 2=Post creation/submission, 3=External link navigation, 4=Like/Upvote.

fields.name: Content_Targeting_Rule
fields.label: Targeting Rule for Friction Trigger
fields.description: 1=Universal friction (all links/shares), 2=Unopened-link trigger only, 3=Suspect/flagged content trigger only.

fields.name: Primary_Behavioral_Outcome
fields.label: Primary Outcome Metric
fields.description: 1=Sharing intention (self-report), 2=Observed platform sharing (digital trace), 3=Link click-through/reading rate, 4=Sharing discernment (true vs. false sharing-rate delta).

options.label: Sharing discernment (true vs. false sharing-rate delta)

fields.name: Friction_Disclosed
fields.label: Friction Disclosed to User
fields.description: 1=Yes (rationale shown), 0=No (silent friction), null=Unclear.

social_norms.label: Social Norms
social_norms.description: Nudging interventions that mobilize descriptive or injunctive social information (peer influence, collective standards) to steer people away from believing or sharing unverified information (Kozyreva et al., 2024). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Norm_Type
fields.label: Social Norm Type
fields.description: 1=Descriptive norm (what most people do), 2=Injunctive norm (what is approved/disapproved), 3=Dynamic norm (trending change in peer behaviour), 4=Combined descriptive and injunctive.

options.label: Dynamic norm (trending change in peer behaviour)

fields.name: Norm_Framing
fields.label: Normative Framing
fields.description: 1=Positive/truth-promoting framing, 2=Negative/misinformation-discouraging framing.

fields.name: Reference_Group
fields.label: Reference Group Specified
fields.description: 1=Broad platform peer group, 2=National/fellow-citizen group, 3=Ideological/in-group peers, 4=Unspecified/generic social consensus, 5=Local community.

fields.name: Delivery_Format
fields.label: Presentation Format
fields.description: 1=Statistical normative statement/banner, 2=Simulated social counter/ upvote ratio, 3=Peer comment feedback prompt, 4=Interactive norm elicitation task.

fields.name: Primary_Target_Variable
fields.label: Primary Behavioral / Cognitive Outcome
fields.description: 1=Sharing intentions, 2=Belief in misinformation, 3=Flagging/reporting suspicious content, 4=Discernment score.

fields.name: Ingroup_Congruence
fields.label: In-group Congruence of Norm Source
fields.description: 1=Ideological in-group source, 2=Out-group/general source, 3=Not applicable, null=Unclear.

platform_exposure_reduction.label: Platform Exposure Reduction / Downranking
platform_exposure_reduction.description: Platform- or system-level interventions that reduce, downrank, demote, or remove low-quality or untrustworthy content (feed algorithm changes, exposure-reduction field experiments, deplatforming). Use with the common core.

fields.name: Exposure_Mechanism
fields.label: Exposure Mechanism
fields.description: 1=Downranking/demotion in feed or search, 2=Removal/deletion of content, 3=Deplatforming/account removal, 4=Reduced distribution/reach, 5=Warning interruption before exposure, 6=Other.

fields.description: 1=Untrustworthy sources/domains, 2=False content items, 3=Engagement/reach threshold, 4=Universal exposure limit, 5=Other.

fields.name: Primary_Outcome
fields.label: Primary Outcome

fields.name: Assignment_Level

fields.name: Content_Harm_Level

generic.label: Generic Misinformation Intervention
generic.description: Misinformation/media-literacy interventions that are not primarily psychological inoculation or source-evaluation training, e.g. debunking corrections, media-literacy lessons, accuracy nudges, fact-checking training, open-mindedness interventions, or platform exposure-reduction experiments. sourcing.label: Sourcing / Source Evaluation
sourcing.description: Studies of sourcing and source-evaluation training interventions, typically lateral reading, click restraint, CRAAP/checklist evaluation, or fact-checking strategies that teach participants to evaluate the credibility of sources and online information. fields.name: Source_Eval_Strategy
